variables.name: KOVCHEG_APP_ENV
variables.constraint: exactly development, staging, or production; staging and production application services require NODE_ENV=production
variables.restart: recreate api-1, api-2, auth, worker, web, and rerun the migration entrypoint
variables.rotation: requires a separately configured environment with distinct data, secrets, URLs, and provider settings

variables.name: KOVCHEG_API_IMAGE
variables.constraint: registry reference ending in @sha256:<64 lowercase hex>

variables.name: KOVCHEG_AUTH_IMAGE
variables.constraint: registry reference ending in @sha256:<64 lowercase hex>

variables.name: KOVCHEG_WEB_IMAGE
variables.constraint: registry reference ending in @sha256:<64 lowercase hex>

variables.name: KOVCHEG_WORKER_IMAGE
variables.constraint: registry reference ending in @sha256:<64 lowercase hex>

variables.name: KOVCHEG_EDGE_IMAGE
variables.constraint: registry reference ending in @sha256:<64 lowercase hex>

variables.name: KOVCHEG_POSTGRES_IMAGE
variables.constraint: registry reference ending in @sha256:<64 lowercase hex>
variables.restart: migration and database operations require the exact same approved image

variables.name: KOVCHEG_API_IMAGE_DIGEST
variables.constraint: sha256:<64 lowercase hex> and equal to KOVCHEG_API_IMAGE digest

variables.name: KOVCHEG_AUTH_IMAGE_DIGEST
variables.constraint: sha256:<64 lowercase hex> and equal to KOVCHEG_AUTH_IMAGE digest

variables.name: KOVCHEG_WEB_IMAGE_DIGEST
variables.constraint: sha256:<64 lowercase hex> and equal to KOVCHEG_WEB_IMAGE digest

variables.name: KOVCHEG_WORKER_IMAGE_DIGEST
variables.constraint: sha256:<64 lowercase hex> and equal to KOVCHEG_WORKER_IMAGE digest

variables.name: KOVCHEG_AUTH_EMAIL_FROM_ADDRESS
variables.constraint: verified sender controlled outside the repository

variables.name: KOVCHEG_AUTH_EMAIL_FROM_NAME
variables.constraint: 1 to 128 visible characters

variables.name: KOVCHEG_AUTH_OIDC_ISSUER
variables.constraint: bare HTTPS origin; must match the approved ingress identity

variables.name: KOVCHEG_WEB_OIDC_AUTHORIZATION_ENDPOINT
variables.constraint: HTTPS authorization endpoint on the exact configured issuer origin

variables.name: KOVCHEG_WEB_OIDC_CLIENT_ID
variables.constraint: 3 to 128 safe identifier characters; must select one exact public openid client
variables.restart: restart auth and web after migrating the matching registration

variables.name: KOVCHEG_WEB_OIDC_ISSUER
variables.constraint: bare HTTPS origin equal to the application auth issuer
variables.rotation: requires provider, ingress and client coordination

variables.name: KOVCHEG_WEB_OIDC_REDIRECT_URI
variables.constraint: exact same-origin /bff/auth/oidc/callback URI registered for the public client
variables.restart: restart auth and web after migrating the matching registration
variables.rotation: requires registration, BFF and ingress coordination

variables.name: KOVCHEG_WEB_OIDC_TOKEN_ENDPOINT_AUTH_METHOD
variables.constraint: exactly none; client secret is forbidden
variables.rotation: a client-type change requires a new application security decision

variables.name: KOVCHEG_AUTH_WEBAUTHN_ORIGINS_JSON
variables.constraint: 1 to 8 unique origins within the configured RP ID

variables.name: KOVCHEG_AUTH_WEBAUTHN_RP_ID
variables.constraint: exact production RP allowlist and suffix owner of every allowed origin

variables.name: KOVCHEG_AUTH_WEBAUTHN_RP_NAME
variables.constraint: 1 to 64 characters without controls

variables.name: KOVCHEG_LOOPBACK_PORT
variables.constraint: host loopback only; default 3000

variables.name: KOVCHEG_AUTH_ISSUER_LOOPBACK_PORT
variables.constraint: separate host loopback only; default 3002

variables.name: KOVCHEG_BACKUP_RETENTION_DAYS
variables.constraint: minimum 1; conservative application default 7

variables.name: KOVCHEG_AUTH_ADMIN_BOOTSTRAP_FILE
variables.constraint: owner-readable JSON file; never an inline value
variables.rotation: remove or replace after controlled bootstrap

variables.name: KOVCHEG_AUTH_OIDC_CLIENTS_FILE
variables.constraint: owner-readable JSON file; may contain client credentials
variables.rotation: rotate on client credential compromise or client removal

variables.name: KOVCHEG_AUTH_OIDC_COOKIE_KEYS_FILE
variables.constraint: owner-readable JSON array with at least two strong keys

variables.name: KOVCHEG_AUTH_OIDC_JWKS_FILE
variables.constraint: owner-readable private JWKS

variables.name: KOVCHEG_WEB_OIDC_STATE_KEY_FILE
variables.constraint: owner-readable file containing exactly one 32-byte base64url key; inline value is forbidden
variables.restart: restart web; all outstanding OIDC bindings become invalid
variables.rotation: planned restart or emergency invalidation of outstanding bindings

variables.name: KOVCHEG_AUTH_CHALLENGE_PEPPER_FILE
variables.constraint: non-empty high-entropy value
variables.restart: restart auth; outstanding challenges become invalid
variables.rotation: emergency and planned rotation procedure required

variables.name: KOVCHEG_AUTH_RATE_LIMIT_PEPPER_FILE
variables.constraint: non-empty high-entropy value
variables.rotation: emergency and planned rotation procedure required

variables.name: KOVCHEG_AUTH_SESSION_PEPPER_FILE
variables.constraint: non-empty high-entropy value
variables.restart: restart auth; all existing sessions become invalid
variables.rotation: security event or controlled global logout

variables.name: KOVCHEG_RESEND_API_KEY_FILE
variables.constraint: service-scoped provider credential file
variables.rotation: provider credential rotation and emergency revoke

variables.name: KOVCHEG_REALTIME_RELAY_TOKEN_FILE
variables.constraint: service-scoped high-entropy bearer token file
variables.restart: restart worker and both API instances

variables.name: KOVCHEG_POSTGRES_SUPERUSER_PASSWORD_FILE
variables.constraint: database-scoped password file

variables.name: KOVCHEG_POSTGRES_MIGRATION_PASSWORD_FILE
variables.constraint: migration-role password file

variables.name: KOVCHEG_POSTGRES_RUNTIME_PASSWORD_FILE
variables.constraint: application runtime-role password file

variables.name: KOVCHEG_POSTGRES_AUTH_PASSWORD_FILE
variables.constraint: auth runtime-role password file

variables.name: KOVCHEG_POSTGRES_AUDIT_PASSWORD_FILE
variables.constraint: audit writer-role password file
variables.restart: restart any future audit writer consumer
